scope.statement: Fresh-interpreter import-order diagnosis for frozen private05. The probe imported supervisor as the CLI entrypoint, constructed a temporary source-bound inherited88 plus private05 adapter7 closure, called prepare_current_graph and allowed its normal close path. No engine, replay, admission, native control, JVM, analyzer, qualification, Git or source integration ran.
not_performed: engine, JVM, analyzer, replay, admission, qualification, native controls or launch

supervisor.entrypoint_imports: lines 5-6 import packet and protocol only; no bridge import
supervisor.main: lines 949-955 imports prepare_current_graph; line 974 enters it

packet.prepare_current_graph: lines 145-152 load the four synthetic inherited hosts and prepare inherited88 before bare from bridge import prepare_graph95, close_graph95

independent_probe.construction: Each fresh process imports supervisor from the private05 directory, copies the actual inherited runtime-module refs and manifest into a symlink-free temporary root, copies private05 adapter sources as the seven graph refs, then calls packet.prepare_current_graph(root, core).

observed.bridge_import_event: top-level bridge imported after four _joern05_boot_* host modules were registered

close_result.message: graph import added a non-stdlib process-global sys.modules entry

early_import_control.interpretation: Preloading the same top-level bridge before inherited88 preparation removes the newly-added process-global entry from the frozen baseline, confirming the import-order cause. This is a diagnosis control, not an approval or repair.

findings.finding: A fresh CLI-style interpreter imports supervisor, packet and protocol without top-level bridge. packet.prepare_current_graph then registers the inherited88 host modules and imports bare top-level bridge only afterward. The frozen inherited graph close sees bridge as a newly-added non-stdlib process-global sys.modules entry and raises FrozenBridge19Error during context teardown, after graph95 preparation has succeeded. The normal fresh entrypoint therefore cannot complete the source-only graph lifecycle.

evidence.late_close_error: FrozenBridge19Error: graph import added a non-stdlib process-global sys.modules entry
evidence.early_control: preloaded bridge before inherited88 baseline; graph95 close returned without exception

findings.required_repair: Prepare snapshot06 with an exact source-bound import-order repair that makes the bridge dependency part of the process-global baseline before inherited88 graph preparation, or otherwise removes the bare post-baseline import while preserving the frozen graph's source identity and fail-closed semantics. Re-run the fresh late-import probe and retained ownership/graph tests. Do not weaken or suppress FrozenBridge19Error and do not treat the early preload control as production evidence.

disposition.next_gate: Writer must produce a new private06 source snapshot addressing ADAPTER05-CLI-IMPORT-ORDER-001. Obtain a fresh independent source review before any canonical copy, source commit, runtime control, admission or qualification.
disposition.prior_review_effect: This supplement supersedes the private05 source-commit approval for integration purposes until the fresh-import blocker is repaired and reviewed.

method: Two fresh Python3.13 -B -E processes ran the same temporary source-bound import-only probe: one exact supervisor CLI import order and one preloaded-bridge control. The late path demonstrated the frozen close rejection; the early path isolated import timing as the cause. No production runtime, replay, engine, JVM, analyzer, admission, qualification, native control or Git action ran.
